statutory_group_instance_no_slot: This form prints {count} {group} slots, and this is one more.
statutory_group_instance_goes_to: It will be written into {destination} instead. Nothing is lost, but it will read as a note rather than a filled box.
statutory_revision_soon: Revision {version} replaces this form on {date}. This inspection is dated {inspectionDate} and is not affected; inspections dated on or after {date} need the updated template.
statutory_revision_superseded_elsewhere: Revision {version} took effect on {date}. This inspection is dated {inspectionDate}, so it is still produced from the earlier revision — that is correct, and nothing needs to change here.
statutory_revision_cannot_produce: This inspection is dated {inspectionDate}, which falls under revision {applicable}. This template produces revision {template}, so this form cannot be produced for this inspection. Ask an administrator to update the template, then start this inspection again on the updated one.
statutory_template_retired_superseded: Replaced by a newer revision on {date} — no longer available for new inspections.
statutory_template_retired_uninstalled: Uninstalled on {date} — ask an administrator to reinstall it.
statutory_update_inflight: {count} in-progress inspections stay on revision {version}. Their dates fall inside its window, so they still produce their form.
statutory_update_blocked: {count} of them are dated under revision {version} and will not be able to produce the form at all. They have to be started again on the updated template.
statutory_update_none_blocked: None of them is dated under a newer revision, so this update costs nothing that is already in progress.
